lines.text: I'm shook, I got a perfect score!

data.define: Used when you are very shocked or upset by something.

example.text: I'm shook, I got a perfect score!

misuse.text: Don't say 'shook' after drinking a milkshake.

publish.title: What does "shook" mean?
publish.value: Shook = Very surprised or shaken. Example: "I'm shook, I got a perfect score!" (very casual English, US).
